card.name: The word clearance in drug interactions
card.fires_on: The word "clearance" when it is the drug-elimination term, usually after "the" or a drug name, in interaction or geriatric dosing text.

modes.label: After "the"
modes.description: "clearance" follows "the" and describes how a drug changes the elimination of another drug.
